About Me

I’m an MEng Mechanical Engineering student at the University of Edinburgh — awarded the First Year Class Medal for top performance in my cohort — currently on exchange at Cornell University with a 3.78 GPA, and predicted to graduate with First-Class honours in 2028. My interests centre on sustainable design, structural analysis, and product development, with hands-on experience in ANSYS, Python, and Fusion 360.

Most recently I led my team to 1st place at the BUiD Sustainability Spring School in Dubai, developing an innovative lighting solution with engineers and architects from across the world.
